assets.semanticIdentity: One acorn wrapped in a three-loop root knot.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Rune Scribe Wildwood production Seal color master
Primary request: Create one independent Acorn Knot medallion faithful to the approved Wildwood craftsmanship. It must unmistakably depict one mature acorn wrapped by one continuous root cord forming exactly three broad interlaced loops.
Input images: Image 1 is the controlling Wildwood style board and Image 2 is the controlling Wildwood catalog. Use both only for material, palette, botanical craftsmanship, relief, and finish. Do not copy, crop, trace, reconstruct, or reproduce any screenshot composition or object from them.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent exterior around the isolated emblem; no scene, panel, card, or rectangular backing.
Subject: one centered circular dark elderbark and deep forest-green enamel medallion with an aged bronze-silver rim; a bold dimensional acorn at center; exactly three readable root-knot loops surrounding and supporting it; restrained moss and tiny leaf details within the emblem.
Style/medium: high-fidelity dimensional fantasy metalwork and hand-carved wood relief, grounded natural weight, aged bronze, dark walnut bark, restrained green enamel and moss, consistent with the approved Wildwood object family.
Composition/framing: frontal orthographic, centered, isolated 1:1 canvas, generous transparent margin, full uncropped rim. Keep the acorn and three-loop knot bold and readable at 48-64 pixels.
Lighting/mood: filtered forest light, premium, ancient, quiet, no harsh bloom.
Constraints: actual alpha transparency outside the emblem; exactly one independent emblem; exactly one acorn; exactly three broad root-knot loops; crisp edges, full rim, internal relief and shadow.
Avoid: all text, letters, numbers, glyphs, runes, writing, sigils, logos, UI, buttons, cards, frames, screenshots, scenery, multiple emblems, animals, insects, flat line-icon styling, neon outlines, watermark.

postprocess.method: deterministic near-white exterior key followed by uniform Lanczos downscale
postprocess.purpose: remove the generated checker field while preserving the complete rendered emblem and true exterior alpha

review.notes: One centered acorn and three broad interlaced root loops remain distinct at compact scale; the complete rim, relief, moss, and natural material hierarchy are preserved. Owner review remains pending.
